EnrollFace_TimeoutForReLookForFace_ms.blurb: ms without seeing the enrollee face before aborting scan and re-looking; also scales timeout extension when a face is first found.

EnrollFace_UpdateFacePositionThreshold_m.blurb: Pose translation threshold (mm) to treat a different FaceID as the same enrollee in MatchesBasedOnPose.

EnrollFace_UpdateFaceAngleThreshold_deg.blurb: Pose angle threshold (deg) for matching a different FaceID to the current enrollee pose.

EnrollFace_Timeout_sec.blurb: Default overall enrollment timeout (s) copied into InstanceConfig at behavior construction.
EnrollFace_Timeout_sec.statusNote: Only seeds InstanceConfig.timeout_sec at construct (line 257); runtime CONSOLE_VAR changes do not re-read into an existing behavior. Session uses _dVars->timeout_sec from that copy, then TimeoutMax extension.

EnrollFace_TimeoutMax_sec.blurb: Hard cap (s) when extending timeout after a face is found (plus re-look × max enroll samples).

EnrollFace_DriveForwardIntentDist_mm.blurb: Forward drive distance (mm) after choosing a face, signaling intent before scanning (treads free).

EnrollFace_DriveForwardIntentSpeed_mmps.blurb: Speed (mm/s) for the post-face-found intent DriveStraightAction.

EnrollFace_MinTrackingPanAngle_deg.blurb: TrackFaceAction pan tolerance (deg); small angles clamped so body keeps micro-moving while tracking.

EnrollFace_MinTrackingTiltAngle_deg.blurb: TrackFaceAction tilt tolerance (deg); small angles clamped so head keeps micro-moving while tracking.

EnrollFace_MinBackup_mm.blurb: Min random backup distance (mm) while looking around for a face.

EnrollFace_MaxBackup_mm.blurb: Max random backup distance (mm) while looking around for a face.

EnrollFace_MaxTotalBackup_mm.blurb: Cap on cumulative backup distance (mm) during look-around; no more reverse once exceeded.

EnrollFace_MaxTurnTowardsFaceAngle_rad.blurb: Max turn angle (rad) for TurnTowardsFace / TurnTowardsLastFacePose when seeking a face (default π).

EnrollFace_NumImagesToWait.blurb: VisionMode::Faces frames to wait after turn / look-around before deciding next enroll step.

EnrollFace_NumImagesToWaitInPlace.blurb: Faces frames to wait in place (head up) before first look-around, so vision can refresh FaceWorld.

EnrollFace_DefaultMaxFacesVisible.blurb: Default maxFacesVisible for JSON config.get; more simultaneous faces starts the too-many-faces clock.
EnrollFace_DefaultMaxFacesVisible.statusNote: Only used as construction-time JSON default into InstanceConfig; live path uses _iConfig->maxFacesVisible, not this CONSOLE_VAR at runtime.

EnrollFace_DefaultTooManyFacesTimeout_se.blurb: Default tooManyFacesTimeout_sec for JSON config.get; how long >max faces may persist before timeout fail.
EnrollFace_DefaultTooManyFacesTimeout_se.statusNote: Construction-time JSON default only; HasTimedOut uses _iConfig->tooManyFacesTimeout_sec.

EnrollFace_DefaultTooManyFacesRecentTime.blurb: Default tooManyFacesRecentTime_sec for JSON config.get; recency window for counting multi-face observations.
EnrollFace_DefaultTooManyFacesRecentTime.statusNote: Construction-time JSON default only; multi-face logic uses _iConfig->tooManyFacesRecentTime_sec.

EnrollFace_TicksForKnownNameBeforeFail.blurb: Observations of a named wrong face (without idChanged) before IsSeeingWrongFace treats it as fail-worthy.

EnrollFace_ScoreThresholdToFailOnWrongFa.blurb: If max match score of a wrong named face exceeds this, refuse/enroll path treats it as high-confidence wrong face.

EnrollFace_MaxInterruptionBeforeReset_ms.blurb: While deactivated mid-enroll, ms since last deactivation before DisableEnrollment resets the request.

EnrollFace_FailOnWrongFace.blurb: true: wrong named face fails enrollment; false: say name (per SayWrongNameMode) and resume looking.

EnrollFace_SayWrongNameMode.blurb: u8 enum when handling wrong face: 0=Off (no TTS), 1=Short (name!), 2=Long (localized already-know lines). Default Long.
EnrollFace_SayWrongNameMode.statusNote: Comment says it only matters if FailOnWrongFace==false for continuing; switch still runs on wrong-face path either way.
